---
pagetitle: "Publications"
toc: false
title-block-style: default  # default, plain, none
page-layout: full
listing:
  - id: articles
    contents: articles/*/*.qmd
    template: _ejs/article.ejs
    categories: false
    sort:
      - "year desc"
      - "title"
    sort-ui: [year, title, author, publication]
    filter-ui: [year, title, author, publication]
    page-size: 100
    field-display-names: 
      publication: "Publication"
      year: "Year"
format:
  html: 
    fontsize: 1.1em
    include-after-body: year_divider.html
    css: year_divider.css
---

:::{#articles}
